This relationship implies that Ipatasertib may modulate Granzyme B activity via a non-direct mechanism, possibly by affecting the expression or function of the intermediate protein. The evidence suggests a possible regulatory relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The integration of these pathways highlights the complexity of drug-target interactions and underscores the importance of considering intermediate targets in understanding the full biological impact of a drug.
